summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of duplicate yields in HashedFilesMixin's post_process() method, which can lead to incorrect statistics and unnecessary processing.

issues.description: The patch introduces a new dictionary `processed_adjustable_paths` to store and yield adjustable files at the end. This could potentially introduce a behavioral regression if other parts of the code rely on the order or timing of the yields.
The code becomes slightly more complex with the introduction of the new dictionary and additional logic, which may affect maintainability.
